**Finding submitted: `missing` (INSURANCE), confidence 0.62.**

What I found:
- The only insurance language in the Agreement is permissive/cost-based — Paragraph 5.3 (p0139) allows each Party to insure its own cost share voluntarily, and p0133 treats insurance (or an allowance in lieu where a Party self-insures) as a cost element. No coverage obligation, no minimum limits, no E&O or cyber cover anywhere.
- Third-party "Suppliers" under the Supply Contract are not parties here; the vendor-analogue role is held by the Terminal Parties / Maintenance Authorities, who under Paragraph 10 operate and maintain the Wet Segment, Segment T and the terminal stations through which our Allocated Capacity is carried and which we access.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): one `insert_after` at p0260 (Paragraph 25, miscellaneous area) adding Paragraph 25A requiring each Terminal Party and each Maintenance Authority to maintain E&O cover of at least USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy cover of at least USD 2,000,000.

Drafting choices:
- Targeted the **fallback** (two elements) as the shortest complete cure; both elements mapped to operation 1.
- Bound only the Terminal Parties/Maintenance Authorities, not "each Party", so the covenant does not rebound onto Teleglobe USA.
- Omitted preferred-only extras (CGL limits, workers' compensation, certificates) and the model clause's at-own-expense and one-year survival tails, none of which a selected fallback element requires; Paragraph 5.3 is left untouched as it is neutral-to-beneficial to us.
